institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for an efficient and environmentally clean process for the de-skinning of pepper.
description: A zero-discharge microbial bioprocess for white pepper production where fermentative de-skinning of pepper takes place. The technology has been awarded the NRDC technology Award and the WIPO Gold medal (2009).
applications: Industrial processing of premium white pepper grades , Manufacturing of specialized biological retting formulations , Deployment in eco-friendly, zero-discharge spice processing centers ,Commercial cultivation value-addition loops for pepper farmers
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
